project.title: RIME against PBX1 protein in P19.6 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells treated for 48 hours with all-trans retinoic acid
project.projectDescription: Identification of PBX1 interactors in P19.6 mouse embryonal carcinoma cells treated for 48 hours with all-trans retinoic acid.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Cells were processed as described in Serandour et al, Nucleic Acids Research 2012. RIMEs were performed as described in Mohammed et al, Cell Reports 2013, with the antibody anti-PBX1 from Abnova reference H00005087-M01. Control RIMEs were performed with non-immune serum from mouse.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Raw MS/MS data in Thermo Fisher .RAW format and mzIdentML exported from Scaffold
